Identify the type of the underlined clause: I know that he is honest. (that he is honest)
The clause is the object of ‘know’, so it is a noun clause.
Identify the type of the underlined clause: This is the house where I was born. (where I was born)
It describes the noun ‘house’, so it is an adjective clause.
Identify the type of the underlined clause: I will wait until you come. (until you come)
It tells ‘when’ about the verb ‘wait’, so it is an adverb clause of time.
